US Court Dismisses Criminal Case Against Gautam Adani

A US court has dismissed a criminal case filed against Indian industrialist Gautam Adani. The court's decision provides Adani with significant relief. Following the ruling, Gautam Adani stated that "truth has won." The case was dismissed by a US judge.
